The '''Separatist Base''' was a bunker which served as headquarters for some of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian Separatists]] on the island of [[Mannett Point]] in [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], during the [[Separatist War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Separatist Base first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
